description: Measures GPU shared memory (LDS/SMEM) bandwidth with two access patterns: no-conflict (stride-1, zero bank conflicts) and conflict (all warp lanes access the same bank, 32-way bank conflict). Reports bandwidth in GB/s.

scaling_param.name: inner_iters
scaling_param.description: Number of inner-loop iterations per kernel launch; controls total shared memory traffic

non_scaling_params.name: num_blocks
non_scaling_params.description: Number of thread blocks in the grid

non_scaling_params.name: access_pattern
non_scaling_params.description: Shared memory access pattern: no_conflict (stride-1) or conflict (same bank)
